visual_action: A slideshow of still photos shows cutouts of Joe Biden's face, stylized as the 'Dark Brandon' meme with sunglasses and glowing eyes, placed around Miami. One photo shows a large cutout held in front of a billboard for an 'NBC NEWS REPUBLICAN PRESIDENTIAL DEBATE'. Other photos show numerous cutouts staked into grassy medians and roadsides near signs for 'PortMiami' and in front of city buildings.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: The video is centered around cutouts of his face, styled as the 'Dark Brandon' meme, which is explicitly named in the on-screen text: 'Dark Brandon made a surprise appearance...'

cast.name: Republican Party
cast.evidence: The on-screen text refers to 'the GOP debate,' and a billboard shown in the first image advertises the 'REPUBLICAN PRESIDENTIAL DEBATE'.

cast.name: NBC News
cast.evidence: The NBC News logo and name appear on a billboard for the Republican debate shown in the first clip.

on_screen_text.text: Dark Brandon made a surprise appearance at the GOP debate today
NBC NEWS REPUBLICAN PRESIDENTIAL DEBATE WEDNESDAY NOV 8

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video, only music.
audio_music: An upbeat soul track, 'Hit the Road Jack', plays throughout the video. The lyrics ('Hit the road Jack and don't you come back no more') create a mocking and dismissive tone aimed at the subjects of the Republican debate.
editing_pacing: The video is a simple slideshow of still photographs with basic transitions between them.
manipulation_or_satire: In some of the photos, a glowing red lens flare effect has been digitally added to the eyes of the Joe Biden cutouts to enhance the 'Dark Brandon' meme's laser-eyes visual trope.
cultural_references: The song 'Hit the Road Jack', famously performed by Ray Charles.
central_claim: Democrats successfully trolled the Republican presidential debate by placing 'Dark Brandon' cutouts around the event venue in Miami.
intended_effect: To make viewers feel amused by the political stunt and see the Democratic party as cleverly mocking their Republican opponents.
